adjudication.rationale: In the migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` the legacy `embeddable_hosts` setting is split on `"\n"` and inserted via raw SQL: `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` without any normalization/stripping. This bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` that would remove `http(s)://` and paths. After upgrade, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` parses the request URL and matches with `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, so rows stored as `http://discourse.org`, `https://example.com/1234`, or with trailing `\r`/spaces will not match `uri.host` and `host_allowed?` will return false, causing `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to raise `InvalidAccess`.
